name: TX-29
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with a +17 partisan lean
Incumbent Sylvia Garcia running with a large fundraising edge
Republican challenger has raised no money
model.rationale: Garcia holds a heavily Democratic Houston-area seat, has out-raised an opponent who has reported no fundraising, and benefits from outside spending on her side. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy incumbent win.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or unexpected outside spending against Garcia would be the main signal to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Sylvia Garcia seeks another term in a Houston-area district that leans Democratic by about 17 points. She is a well-established incumbent who has raised nearly a million dollars and benefits from outside spending on her behalf, while Republican challenger Martha Fierro has reported no fundraising and no outside support.

With no public polling and no expert ratings, the race rests on fundamentals, which strongly favor the incumbent. Prediction markets price Garcia's chances near 97 percent. The forecast expects a comfortable double-digit Democratic win, with low but nonzero uncertainty given the absence of direct polling in the district.
